insight: Built by Translated, an Italian firm founded in 1999 that pioneered adaptive machine translation back in 2011.
name: ModernMT
tagline: Adaptive neural machine translation that learns from your corrections.
description: Translated's machine translation engine, ModernMT, is an adaptive neural MT system that adapts to context and learns from human corrections in real time without retraining. It pools project data and translation memories to deliver custom-engine quality on the fly. The core engine is open source, and the hosted Hyper Adaptive service offers managed custom models.

modelSupport.notes: Open-source adaptive NMT (Fairseq Transformer base); self-hostable or hosted via Translated.

edge: Adapts per string from your TM and edits on the fly, so there's no per-customer engine retraining like older custom-MT setups.
